import pandas as pd
import re

file_path = '/data/national_programme_ledger.xlsx'

field = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Field Expenses', skiprows=4)
salary = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Salary Register', skiprows=5)
lookup = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Cost Centre Lookup', skiprows=3)

# Helper functions
def normalize_code(s):
    if pd.isna(s):
        return ''
    return str(s).strip().lower()

def clean_amount(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return 0.0
    s = str(val).strip()
    # remove ₹ and commas
    s = s.replace('₹', '').replace(',', '')
    try:
        return float(s)
    except:
        return 0.0

def normalize_status(s):
    if pd.isna(s):
        return ''
    return str(s).strip().lower()

# Normalize lookup
lookup['norm_code'] = lookup['Cost Centre Code'].apply(normalize_code)
# Build mapping code -> programme
code_to_programme = dict(zip(lookup['norm_code'], lookup['Programme']))

# Process field expenses
field['norm_cost_centre'] = field['Cost Centre'].apply(normalize_code)
field['norm_status'] = field['Posting Status'].apply(normalize_status)
field['txn_id_str'] = field['Transaction ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
field['amount_clean'] = field['Amount (INR)'].apply(clean_amount)

field_eligible = field[
    field['txn_id_str'].str.startswith('FE-') &
    (field['norm_status'] == 'posted') &
    field['norm_cost_centre'].isin(code_to_programme.keys())
].copy()

field_eligible['programme'] = field_eligible['norm_cost_centre'].map(code_to_programme)

# Process salary
salary['norm_cost_centre'] = salary['Cost Centre'].apply(normalize_code)
salary['norm_status'] = salary['Payroll Status'].apply(normalize_status)
salary['payroll_id_str'] = salary['Payroll Line ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
salary['salary_clean'] = salary['Gross Salary (INR)'].apply(clean_amount)

salary_eligible = salary[
    salary['payroll_id_str'].str.startswith('PAY-') &
    (salary['norm_status'] == 'paid') &
    salary['norm_cost_centre'].isin(code_to_programme.keys())
].copy()

salary_eligible['programme'] = salary_eligible['norm_cost_centre'].map(code_to_programme)

# Filter for Rural Livelihoods
programme_name = 'Rural Livelihoods'
field_rl = field_eligible[field_eligible['programme'] == programme_name]
salary_rl = salary_eligible[salary_eligible['programme'] == programme_name]

field_sum = field_rl['amount_clean'].sum()
salary_sum = salary_rl['salary_clean'].sum()
combined = field_sum + salary_sum
pct_salary = (salary_sum / combined * 100) if combined > 0 else 0

print("Field RL rows:", len(field_rl))
print(field_rl[['Transaction ID','Cost Centre','Amount (INR)','amount_clean','programme']])
print("\nSalary RL rows:", len(salary_rl))
print(salary_rl[['Payroll Line ID','Cost Centre','Gross Salary (INR)','salary_clean','programme']])
print("\nField sum:", field_sum)
print("Salary sum:", salary_sum)
print("Combined:", combined)
print("Pct salary:", pct_salary)
